_readme: Questions matching any entry below are answered with a live web search instead of the
model's built-in knowledge. Search adds roughly 11 seconds per turn, so keep this list to
Editing: the file is re-read automatically when it changes — no server restart needed.
A bad entry is ignored and the previous list stays active, so a typo cannot break chat.
Verify changes with: node scripts/web-search-trigger-check.js "your question"
Entries are matched case-insensitively at word boundaries, so "news" matches
"any news?" but not "newsletter". Regular expression syntax is allowed:
(?:x|y)  either x or y, e.g. "how much (?:is|are)"
x?       optional, e.g. "headlines?" matches headline and headlines
Backslashes must be doubled in JSON.
Separate from this file, any four digit year from 2020 on also forces a search,
so "the 2026 election" works without a keyword.
The OPENAI_WEB_SEARCH_KEYWORDS environment variable adds to this list.
Set OPENAI_CHAT_WEB_SEARCH=false to disable web search entirely.

_volatileSubjects: Answers that change over time even though the question sounds timeless.
'Who is POTUS' reads like a fixed fact, but the model's training data has a
cutoff, so answering from memory returns whoever held the office back then.
